Select: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, drug_indication.efo_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4, drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%cancer%'. Sort: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, molecule_dictionary.pref_name ASC, compound_structures.canonical_smiles ASC, drug_indication.efo_id ASC, drug_indication.mesh_heading ASC, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind ASC.
